metadata.title: World Digest — November 26, 2026
metadata.summary: Trump's sweeping tariff proposals on 14 nations threaten global trade while Nvidia sinks 3.91% amid governance turmoil.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Trump Proposes New Tariffs on China, EU, and 12 Other Trading Partners

The administration unveiled sweeping tariff proposals targeting 14 nations, reigniting trade war fears and potentially raising U.S. average tariff rates to pre-World War II levels. The New York Times

Deadly Tanker Capsizes Near Ibiza, Killing One Crew Member

A diesel tanker with 17 aboard sank off Ibiza, killing one crew member, with pollution concerns mounting as authorities assess environmental risks. BBC

Ebola Outbreak in Congo Reaches 12,000 Cases

Congo's Ebola crisis hit 12,000 cases as violence forced responders to evacuate, threatening containment efforts amid a death toll exceeding 5,700. ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos

Storm Batters East Coast, Disrupting Thanksgiving Travel

A major storm grounded flights, knocked out power for over 850,000, and triggered coastal flood alerts for 67 million during peak holiday travel. The Washington Post

Thanksgiving Snowstorm Buries St. Louis

St. Louis saw its second-snowiest Thanksgiving on record, leaving 125,000 homes without power for potentially multiple days. STLPR

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

  • UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces a major Labour Party rebellion as nearly 100 MPs, including ministerial aides, oppose the Rosebank oil field development BBC. Separately, net migration to the UK fell to its lowest level since 1997, excluding the pandemic period The New York Times.
  • US President Donald Trump stated he asked Vladimir Putin to "pull back" military aggression throughout Europe Reuters. The administration also proposed new tariffs on China, the EU, and 12 other trading partners The New York Times.
  • Sweden's Ulf Kristersson is poised to remain prime minister after the Centre Party shifted support, avoiding a government role for far-right ministers POLITICO.eu.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets

Global stocks rebounded as the AI trade recovered, with US futures pointing higher Bloomberg. The Dow closed higher after erasing an 1,100-point loss, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell but recovered from lows MarketWatch. Deutsche Bank predicts the tech rout will bottom soon, followed by a 25% S&P 500 rally MarketWatch.

Nvidia Turmoil

Trump pressed Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang amid governance scandals The Washington Post The Hill. S&P placed Nvidia on downgrade watch over “key man” risks TechCrunch. New chip curbs target Chinese buyers CNBC CBS News.

Other News

Oil rose on Middle East supply risks CNN. Norse Atlantic suspended flights BBC. The ECB named its first Spanish president Al Jazeera.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Apple Pulls Chinese Chatbot Talkie Over Child-Safety Concerns

Apple removed the Chinese-developed AI companion app Talkie from its App Store worldwide after an investigation reported sexual messages sent to children Fox Business. The move follows similar child-safety actions and highlights ongoing scrutiny of AI chatbots Fox Business.

Ford Unveils GT41 Hypercar for Le Mans Return

Ford revealed the GT41 hypercar, aiming to win the 2027 24 Hours of Le Mans Ars Technica. A Thanksgiving ad, narrated by Matt Damon and directed by Zack Snyder, supports the racing comeback Ars Technica.

GTA VI Strains PS5 Consoles

Reports indicate Grand Theft Auto VI acts as the "toughest real-world PlayStation 5 stress test," drawing 220W with minimal on-screen action Wccftech. Some consoles reportedly died or smoked, prompting player concern Wccftech.

Black Friday Tech Deals Dominate

Major discounts hit MacBooks, with the M6 MacBook Pro at record lows and the MacBook Neo dropping to $599 MacRumors 9to5Mac. Laptop, TV, and gaming deals also saw significant price cuts CNN USA Today.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ devoured the Thanksgiving box office with an $85M five-day debut Deadline. U2 honored Dolly Parton during the NFL’s Thanksgiving Eve halftime show Forbes. King Crimson co-founder Michael Giles died at 84 The Guardian, alongside Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor at 65 NPR. Essence Music Festival bid farewell to New Orleans after 30 years AP News.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

No IPOs priced or listed in the recent calendar beyond existing names; upcoming listings include NovaGold (NG) and PBT Land and Minerals (PBT) on NYSE, dated 2026-12-02 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

S&P 500 slipped 0.25% to 7,182.78; Nasdaq fell 0.62%, while Dow rose 0.33% and Russell 2000 gained 0.71% Yahoo Finance. VIX dropped 5.27% to 26.80 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Materials led with a 2.07% jump; Communication Services (+0.89%) and Industrials (+0.83%) followed Yahoo Finance. Technology lagged at -0.83%, with Health Care down 0.56% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Meta surged 3.40%; Apple added 0.43% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia tumbled 3.91%, Amazon fell 3.12%, and Alphabet lost 2.13% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Top gainers: BZ +12.6%, LBTYB +11.9%, HPQ +11.5% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Losers: NTNX -15.2%, URBN -10.3% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Most active: NVDA, ANT, SPCX Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield fell 1.14% to 4.85% Yahoo Finance. WTI crude rose 1.47% to $84.91; gold gained 1.63% to $3,593.40 Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin edged up 0.18% to $60,486.65 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • Tariff fallout: Markets may swing on retaliation signals from China/EU after Trump’s sweeping proposal; watch tech and materials volatility.
  • Storm recovery: Power restoration in St. Louis and East Coast could ripple into retail logistics ahead of Black Friday weekend.
  • Ebola containment: Congo evacuation risks may prompt updated WHO guidance.

Next Week

  • Nvidia downgrade watch: S&P decision could amplify AI-sector turbulence; monitor Huang reinstatement news.
  • ECB leadership: New Spanish president’s first signals may shift eurozone rate expectations.
  • GTA VI strain reports: Could pressure Sony’s PS5 narrative ahead of holiday sales.

Next Month

  • NovaGold/PBT listings may test IPO appetite amid trade uncertainty.
